info.name: Tiffin hub - UrbanPiper test orders
info.description:
Sends Swiggy and Zomato orders to the hub exactly as UrbanPiper does (its order webhook), for testing the ODS without a real platform order.

Set the collection variables first:
- hub: the hub's address, e.g. https://140-1-2-3.sslip.io (no / at the end)
- bizId: the UrbanPiper Biz ID from Hub settings
- token: the hub's webhook secret (read it once on the server: sudo sqlite3 /var/lib/tiffin-hub/hub.db "SELECT webhook_token FROM up_account")
- storeRef: the store's ID at UrbanPiper (the store page on the hub admin page)

Each order request makes a new order number by itself; 'Platform cancels the last order' cancels the one sent last.

Note: the shop's accept, ready and cancel go back to UrbanPiper, which does not know these test orders, so those calls show as refused in the store's activity list. That is expected.
